notes.subject: אוב · ידעני
notes.rationale: ov — spirit bilong toktok wantaim ol man dai (medium) o spirit bilong man dai yet; yidoni — man i save save long ol samting hait (familiar spirit/wizard)

notes.subject: מות יומתו
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute: 'dai, ol bai dai tru' — Tok Pisin 'dai tru' i holim strong bilong daunim

notes.subject: blut bilong ol i stap long ol yet
notes.rationale: Pasin bilong kot: blut i stap long ol yet — ol yet i karim het bilong pait, i no long narapela man

translation: Na man o meri, sapos ol i gat long ol spirit bilong toktok wantaim ol man dai, o man i save save long ol samting hait, ol bai dai tru; ol bai trowim ston long ⟨את⟩ ol; blut bilong ol i stap long ol yet.

tokens.gloss: spirit bilong toktok wantaim ol man dai
man i save save long ol samting hait
